description:
Convert documents between formats with pandoc: Markdown, HTML, DOCX, ODT, EPUB, RST, LaTeX, RTF, plain text and PDF. Input as text (content), file (file_base64, max 10 MB: docx, odt, epub, rtf) or url. Input format is detected automatically or set with from. Text outputs come back as content, binary outputs (docx, odt, epub, pdf) as file_base64. Local file includes and remote images are not loaded. Params: to (required), content or file_base64 or url, from, title. Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"content":"# Quarterly Report

| Quarter | Revenue |
|---|---|
| Q1 | 12 |","to":"docx"}.

content.description: Document text (markdown, html, rst, latex, org, csv ...)

file_base64.description: Binary document (docx, odt, epub, rtf), base64

from.description: Input format, e.g. markdown, html, docx, rst, latex; detected if omitted

name: doc_convert
title: Document Conversion (pandoc)
